property.name: spark.yarn.appMasterEnv.JAVA_HOME
property.description: Java home for the Spark YARN ApplicationMaster and cluster-mode driver. The default follows Spark's feature-gated Java home: secondary when supported, otherwise primary. An explicit path overrides that selection.

property.name: spark.executorEnv.JAVA_HOME
property.description: Java home for Spark executors. The default follows Spark's feature-gated Java home: secondary when supported, otherwise primary. Install the selected runtime at the same path on every worker. An explicit path overrides it.
